name: beta
plain: Picks table indices from the inverse CDF of a Beta distribution, per the code comment on arXiv 2407.12173. With the default α=β=0.6 the indices pile up near both ends, so steps are small at high and low noise and fast in the middle. Indices are rounded to integers and repeats are removed.
math:
M=len(S)−1. u_i = 1 − i/steps, i=0..steps−1.
t_i = rint(BetaPPF(u_i; α, β)·M).
σ_i = S[t_i], skipping a t_i equal to the previous one, then 0.
label: from code
surprise: Repeat removal means beta can silently return fewer steps than asked when many indices round alike, as with extreme alpha/beta (samplers.py:703-706).
